name: meteoric iron
lore_descriptor: dark gray, flecked with iron-shine like distant stars
first_pickup_chronicle: Meteoric iron. It fell out of the sky. Hittite kings had blades of it before iron was understood as a craft — they didn't know what to call the metal but they knew it cut everything else they had.
design_notes: Band C heavy rare_metal. Mult 1.45, weight 1.6, enchant 2. 'ignores_shield_partial' is the unique mechanic — splits shield AC by 25% on hit, just by virtue of how dense the meteoric metal is. Heavy-archetype for the F31-45 gap.
